selected_evidence.requirement: Identify the originating fault using Grafana and Loki
selected_evidence.summary: Grafana was healthy; Loki showed node2’s configuration error first at 2026-09-02T14:24:11.093328Z, followed by dependency failures on nodes3 and 4. Direct inspection confirmed the unknown directive.
Nginx validation succeeded after repair, and the final diff proves the only configuration change was removal of `upstream_timeoutx 5s;`.

selected_evidence.summary: Catalog, orders, and checkout listeners are active/enabled and return HTTP 200; node1’s complete checkout path returns the intact catalog payload.

selected_evidence.requirement: Record findings and preserve incident history and catalog data
